# Shop

> A shop\'s items\, across three releases\.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Crucible-Version: v3` on every request you make. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [Audit](src/operations/API_Audit.md): `POST /audit`. Records an audit entry\. Internal.
- [DeleteItem](src/operations/API_DeleteItem.md): `DELETE /items/{id}`. Deletes an item\.
- [GetItem](src/operations/API_GetItem.md): `GET /things/{id}`. Reads one item\.
- [ListItems](src/operations/API_ListItems.md): `GET /items`. Lists item names\.
- [PutItem](src/operations/API_PutItem.md): `PUT /items/{id}`. Stores an item\.

## Data types

- [AuditInput](src/shapes/AuditInput.md): structure.
- [AuditOutput](src/shapes/AuditOutput.md): structure.
- [Conflict](src/shapes/Conflict.md): error, HTTP 409. Two writers raced\; only the service sees it\. Internal.
- [DeleteItemInput](src/shapes/DeleteItemInput.md): structure.
- [GetItemInput](src/shapes/GetItemInput.md): structure.
- [GetItemOutput](src/shapes/GetItemOutput.md): structure.
- [ItemGone](src/shapes/ItemGone.md): error, HTTP 410. The item was deleted\.
- [ItemLocked](src/shapes/ItemLocked.md): error, HTTP 423. Another writer holds the item\.
- [ItemNotFound](src/shapes/ItemNotFound.md): error, HTTP 404. No item has that id\.
- [Kind](src/shapes/Kind.md): enum. How big an item is\.
- [ListItemsInput](src/shapes/ListItemsInput.md): structure.
- [ListItemsOutput](src/shapes/ListItemsOutput.md): structure.
- [Names](src/shapes/Names.md): list.
- [PutItemInput](src/shapes/PutItemInput.md): structure.
- [PutItemOutput](src/shapes/PutItemOutput.md): structure.
- [Size](src/shapes/Size.md): structure. An item\'s dimensions\.

## Releases

- [Releases](src/releases.md): every supported release, oldest first
- [v1](src/releases/v1.md): what changed in v1
- [v2](src/releases/v2.md): what changed in v2
- [v3](src/releases/v3.md): what changed in v3, the current release

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every page above in one file
- [describe.json](describe.json): the whole reference as JSON (`crucible.describe/1`)
- [changes.json](changes.json): the release chain alone (`crucible.changes/1`)
